name: Cable Standing Chest Fly
steps: Stand centered ahead of two chest-height pulleys in a staggered stance with one handle in each hand.
Brace your core with a slight forward lean and open your arms wide with softly bent elbows.
Sweep both handles forward in wide arcs until your hands meet in front of your chest.
Squeeze your chest briefly, then open your arms back under control until your elbows align with your torso.
tips: Hold a slight bend in your elbows throughout the fly.
Keep your shoulders down and back instead of shrugging or leaning farther forward to close your hands.
